title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: We place the highest priority on the privacy of your data and the security of your information.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when using the Masar X platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal data.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.description: We collect information that you provide directly to us when creating an account or using our services:

items.fullName: Full name and email address upon registration
items.summaries: Study summaries and resources you upload
items.interactions: Comments, ratings, and interactions with content
items.performance: Performance data in tests and exams
items.profileImage: Profile picture (if added to your profile)

collection.detailsNote: Learn about the reasons for collecting each type of information and how it is used

protection.title: Data Protection
protection.content: We use advanced encryption technologies and global security protocols to protect your data from unauthorized access. All data is securely stored via Supabase cloud services.

contact.title: Do you have any inquiries?
contact.description: If you have any questions about our privacy policy, please feel free to contact us.
